summary: This paper resolves four major structural, quantitative, and Diophantine open questions left by Leshem and Sayag regarding repeated entries in Pascal's triangle. By employing centered falling-factorial sandwiches, Pell-Lucas integer descent, zero-Stirling residue identities, and constructive Pellian bounds, the author establishes exact asymptotic error dynamics and pole behavior. All mathematical results are backed by complete formal verification in Lean 4 and AST-audited exact-rational Python certificates.
